citations.quote: Most risk and return models in finance start off with an asset that is defined as risk free, and use the expected return on that asset as the risk-free rate.
On March 8, 2024, for instance, I substituted the expected inflation rate and real GDP growth rate into the regression equation to estimate an expected equity risk premium.
If the estimated value is less than the market price, the analyst infers the security is overvalued.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: The ERP is the expected excess return of the equity market over the riskless rate — the per-unit price of equity-market risk. Damodaran Ch.7 surveys two main estimation routes: historical realized excess returns (window/averaging-sensitive) and implied premium recovered by inverting current prices and forecast cash flows.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Equity Risk Premium Intuition
